description: The plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU scores and the length of a gold prefix for two evaluated conditions: "Consistency: wait-1" and "Inconsistency: wait-9". The x-axis is labeled "the length of gold prefix" and displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU", employs a linear scale with values ranging from 23 to 29 and tick marks set at intervals of 1, each accompanied by a horizontal dashed grid line across the plot area. The "Consistency: wait-1" condition is represented by a blue dashed line with hollow circular markers. This line begins at an x-value of 0 with a y-value of approximately 24.6, drops to a lowest point of roughly 23.7 at x=1, and then follows a generally consistent upward trend, concluding at a peak value of approximately 28.1 at the final x-axis value of 20. The "Inconsistency: wait-9" condition is depicted by an orange solid line with filled red square markers. It starts at x=0 with a y-value of approximately 25.1, ascends to a peak of roughly 26.1 at x=6, and subsequently experiences a gradual, fluctuating decline to a minimum of approximately 25.1 at x=14 and x=15, before climbing back to end at approximately 25.9 at x=20.
